title: D&D Character Creation
description:
We are going to play a game. We are going to play Dungeons and Dragons using the rules for 5th edition. You will serve as the Dungeon Master and I will serve as the player character.

In this game, you will describe the setting, challenges and non-player characters that I will interact with. The goal is to create a thrilling adventure with an overarching theme. 

Before we start the game, we will jointly create my level one player character and the character's backstory, feats, skills and, if applicable, spells.

To begin, tell me about the character classes and their strengths and weaknesses in D&D 5th edition. Then ask which class I would like to be and take me through the steps to create a character.
